title: medbioinf/wf-structural-variants pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for structural variant detection using pangenome graphs and deep learning

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to CSV samplesheet containing the haploid assembly FASTA files.
input.help_text: A comma-separated file with 3 columns (sample, haplotype, fasta) and a header row. Specifies the haploid assemblies used to construct or call against the pangenome graph.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.description: Path to the FASTA reference genome.
fasta.help_text: The primary reference genome used for pangenome graph construction or variant calling.

gfa.description: Path to an existing pangenome GFA file to skip graph construction.
gfa.help_text: If provided, the pipeline will completely skip the pangenome graph construction step and directly use this GFA file to run variant calling for the input samples.

gfa2fa_fa.description: Path to an existing GFA-to-FASTA conversion file.
gfa2fa_fa.help_text: If an existing GFA is provided via --gfa, its pre-extracted FASTA sequence file can be provided here.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

swave_extraction_options.title: Swave Allele Extraction Options
swave_extraction_options.description: Parameters used during the allele preprocessing and snarl extraction phase.

force_reverse.description: Enable original Swave inversion detection and rescue logic for reversed contigs.

remove_small.description: Filter out small snarls/variants below the minimum SV size threshold.

min_sv_size.description: Minimum size (in base pairs) for a variant to be considered a structural variant. Variants smaller than this threshold will be filtered out if `remove_small` is set to true.

spec_snarl.description: Specific snarl ID to process (e.g. '>s1>s3') for debugging/analysis.
spec_snarl.help_text: If provided, the workflow will only extract alleles for this specific snarl. Leave blank/null to process all snarls.

swave_dotplot_options.title: Swave dotplot options
swave_dotplot_options.description: Parameters used during the Swave dotplot generation phase.

kmer_size.help_text: The size of the k-mers used to generate the dotplots. Larger k-mers will result in sparser dotplots that may miss smaller matches, while smaller k-mers will result in denser dotplots that may be more difficult to interpret. The default value is 30.

max_sv_size.description: Maximum size (in base pairs) of variants to include in the dotplots.
max_sv_size.help_text: Variants larger than this threshold will be excluded from the dotplots to improve readability. The default value is 1,000,000 bp (1 Mbp). Adjust this value based on the expected size range of structural variants in your data and the level of detail you want in the dotplots.

spec_path.description: Specific path ID to generate a dotplot for (e.g. 's1>>s3') for debugging/analysis.
spec_path.help_text: If provided, the workflow will only generate a dotplot for this specific path. Leave blank/null to generate dotplots for all paths.

save_dotplot_images.description: Whether to save the generated dotplot images as PNG files.
save_dotplot_images.help_text: If enabled, the generated dotplot images will be saved as PNG files.

swave_projection_options.title: Swave projection options
swave_projection_options.description: Parameters used during the Swave projection generation phase.

save_projections_images.description: Whether to save the the synthesized 6-subplot wave projection PNGs.
save_projections_images.help_text: If enabled, the synthesized 6-subplot wave projection PNGs will be saved.

swave_prediction_options.title: Swave prediction options
swave_prediction_options.description: Parameters used during the Swave deep learning prediction phase.

use_gpu.description: Whether to use GPU for Swave deep learning predictions.
use_gpu.help_text: If enabled, the Swave deep learning predictions will be run on a GPU if available.

model.description: Path to a custom Swave deep learning model .pth file.
model.help_text: If provided, the workflow will use this custom model for predictions instead of the default model. Leave blank/null to use the default pretrained swave model.

swave_variant_calling_options.title: Swave variant calling options
swave_variant_calling_options.description: Parameters used during the Swave variant calling phase.

max_sv_comps.description: Maximum number of SV components for detailed output, otherwise, hyperCPX is used.
max_sv_comps.help_text: If a variant has more components than this threshold, it will be reported as a hypercomplex variant instead of providing detailed output for each component.

dup_to_ins.help_text: If enabled, duplications will be reported as insertions in the output.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
